text.p: CleveTrust Realty Investors said Monday that it has sold its Executive Club Office Building in Denver, Colorado for $5.3 million, resulting in a gain of about $3.5 million.
The company said that as result, the Trust will make its second liquidation distribution in the amount of $1.10 per share on June 19 to shareholders of record June 12.
The combined amount of liquidation distributions made during the third quarter, ending June 30, will be about $3.60 per share.

The Trust also said it has agreed to sell three suburban office buildings in Dallas, Texas for a third liquidation distribution. Assuming the sale occurs, it expects to make a distribution of about $2.00 per share, for a total of $5.60 per share in liquidating distributions during fiscal 1997, ending September 30.

The Trust said it expects its remaining five properties will be sold during calendar year 1998 and the liquidation process completed. It previously said that the total liquidating distributions should have a value in the range of $6.50 to $7.00 per share.
